description: This is a Java test source file for integration testing of loan product features with advanced payment allocations in the Apache Fineract project. It contains test methods for creating, updating, and validating loan products with complex payment allocation rules and related configurations.

classes.name: LoanProductWithAdvancedPaymentAllocationIntegrationTests
classes.description: This class contains integration test cases for verifying the functionality and validation of loan products with advanced payment allocations within the Apache Fineract system.

methods.name: setupTests
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including REST configuration, accounts, and financial activity setup, before all tests run.

methods.name: testCreateAndReadLoanProductWithAdvancedPayment
methods.description: Tests creating a loan product with default and repayment payment allocations and verifies correctness.

methods.name: testUpdateLoanProductOneAllocationIsRemoved
methods.description: Verifies that updating a loan product to remove an allocation rule results in correct removal.

methods.name: testUpdateLoanProductOneAllocationIsAdded
methods.description: Verifies that adding a new payment allocation to a loan product updates it correctly.

methods.name: testUpdateShouldFailWhenNoDefaultAllocationIsProvided
methods.description: Checks that an update fails if the default payment allocation is missing when required.

methods.name: testUpdateShouldFailWhenStrategyIsChangedBackButPaymentAllocationsAreNotRemoved
methods.description: Validates that changing the payment strategy back without removing previous allocations results in failure.

methods.name: testCreateShouldFailWhenNoAllocationRuleIsProvided
methods.description: Ensures that creating a loan product without an allocation rule produces validation errors.

methods.name: testCreateShouldFailWhenNoDefaultAllocationIsProvided
methods.description: Validates failure when creating a loan product with payment allocations but missing default allocation.

methods.name: testCreateAndReadLoanProductWithAdvancedPaymentAndInterestPaymentWaiverTransaction
methods.description: Tests creation and reading of loan product with default and interest waiver allocations.

methods.name: testUpdateLoanProductInterestPaymentWaiverAllocationIsAdded
methods.description: Verifies that interest payment waiver allocation can be added to an existing loan product.

methods.name: testCreateAndReadProgressiveLoanProductWithInterestRefund
methods.description: Tests creating and updating loan products with interest refunds and validates the configurations.

methods.name: testCreateCumulativeLoanProductWithInterestRefund
methods.description: Checks that creating a cumulative loan product with interest refund types fails validation as expected.

methods.name: testCreateShouldFailWhenNoNumberOfRepaymentsIsProvided
methods.description: Verifies that loan product creation fails if the number of repayments is missing.

methods.name: testCreateShouldFailWhenNoInterestRateIsProvided
methods.description: Validates that missing interest rate during creation leads to validation failure.

methods.name: testCreateAndReadProgressiveLoanProductWithChargeOffBehaviour
methods.description: Tests creation and update of loan products with different charge off behaviors.

methods.name: testCreateCumulativeLoanProductWithChargeOff
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for cumulative loan products with charge-off behaviors.

methods.name: loanProductTestBuilder
methods.description: Builds loan product creation requests with customizable parameters.

methods.name: updateLoanProductRequest
methods.description: Creates request objects for updating loan products with advanced payment allocations or strategy codes.

methods.name: createRepaymentPaymentAllocation
methods.description: Constructs an AdvancedPaymentData object for repayment allocations with order rules.

methods.name: createInterestPaymentWaiverAllocation
methods.description: Builds an AdvancedPaymentData object for interest waiver allocations.

methods.name: createDefaultPaymentAllocation
methods.description: Creates a default AdvancedPaymentData allocation rule set.

methods.name: getPaymentAllocationOrder
methods.description: Generates a list of PaymentAllocationOrder objects based on provided payment types.

methods.name: setProperFinancialActivity
methods.description: Sets up financial activity account mapping for transfer accounts.
